cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

mechanism: A conducts precise questions about a visitor's drink choices while avoiding a direct identity question.
confusable: D132 elicits exact source; D222 seeks one hidden fact only through its surroundings.
comparison: Domestic curiosity about visitor identity differs from discreetly probing a gift's price.
seedUse: Keep visitor-cup clues but remove A's direct who questions, which violate the exact Drive.
